name: obsidian-nested-frontmatter-properties
description: An Obsidian plugin that renders and edits nested frontmatter properties, such as arrays of objects, in the native Properties panel.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
